# Design brief template (design → brief.md, before code)

This system is closed-world: every legal component is enumerated in registries/components-index.json and every legal token in registries/tokens-index.json. Anything not in those registries is provably fabricated — do not emit it.

Copy this template to `brief.md` and fill EVERY section from the design input. A row you cannot fill from the registries is a HALT: record it in Open questions and stop — do not build past it.

## 2. Layout regions

Regions are plain elements + CSS (flex/grid) with space tokens — there are no layout components (NR-001). Container styling values must be `var(--ds-*)` tokens.

| Region | Contents (summary) | Container styling (tokens only) | Space rules (gap/padding tokens) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <!-- e.g. header --> | | | |

- Gap vs space steps: the `--ds-space-gap-{sm,md,lg}` trio (tops out at `gap-lg`) is for intra-component rhythm (icon-to-label, control clusters, sibling gaps); larger section- and region-level separation uses the plain space steps (`--ds-space-5` and up).
